reason: Context flow is supported, but attribution to this compiled .bss target is not established by source.

evidence.why: Initializers alone are not layout proof.

reason: Debugger role supported but .data membership and blanket safety not established.
48-byte section, padding and four-object membership require compiled evidence unavailable in this assignment.
Initialized object purposes supported; attribution to compiled .data is unproved.
Initial states and control flow supported, but compiled section assignment remains unproved.
Map and generated local instruction arrays support debugging; source cannot prove .rodata contents or compiler template emission.
Separate observable instruction execution from unproved r4 scratch-address ABI: source passes u128 by value, not an explicit scratch pointer.
Existing guaranteed queue-copy account omits ignored read/post errors and possible uninitialized instruction classification.
Pending-input path does not make PostInterruptEvent process a pending debugger event; it clears the flag and returns without posting.
Flags are set before buffer read; later restore clears both flags but skips DEC hardware write. Existing guarantee of hardware application is incorrect.
Useful missing direct-call reversed-range behavior: zero length but uninitialized error; write flags survive buffer failure.
Add error overwrites, ignored setup errors and non-restored HID2/GQR0 changes, including empty direct-call ranges.
Add sequential error overwrites, attempted-byte accounting and live MSR not restored; loop guard alone does not guarantee each stage succeeded.
Exception report uses debugger-internal exception snapshot, not ordinary stopped-target context.
Completion polarity inverted: completed or absent stepping causes stop; continued active stepping suppresses stop.
Completed stepping is not suppressed; completion clears active, yielding stop notification.
Unsupported-command post can fail; valid-command early service rejection leaves io_result uninitialized, so normalization is not guaranteed.
Recursive suffix starts at map.end rather than end+1 and does not prove complete coverage for arbitrary maps; current map covers full address space. Selector and zero-length caveats matter.
